sn7.2:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn7.2:2.1: bhāradvājagotto kira brāhmaṇo samaṇassa gotamassa santike agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitoti. kupito anattamano yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ asabbhāhi pharusāhi vācāhi akkosati paribhāsati. evaṃ vutte bhagavā akkosakabhāradvājaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
sn7.2:2.3: api nu kho te āgacchanti mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā atithayoti.
sn7.2:2.4: appekadā me bho gotama āgacchanti mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā atithayoti.
sn7.2:2.5: taṃ kiṃ maññasi brāhmaṇa, api nu tesaṃ anuppadesi khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sāyanīyaṃ vāti?
sn7.2:2.6: appekadā nesāhaṃ bho gotama anuppademi khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sāyanīyaṃ vāti.
sn7.2:2.7: sace kho pana te brāhmaṇa nappaṭiggaṇhanti kassa taṃ hotīti.
sn7.2:2.8: sace te bho gotama nappaṭiggaṇhanti amhākameva taṃ hotīti.
sn7.2:2.9: evameva kho brāhmaṇa yaṃ tvaṃ amhe anakkosante akkosasi, arosente rosesi, abhaṇḍante bhaṇḍasi, taṃ te mayaṃ nappaṭiggaṇhāma.
sn7.2:3.1: yo kho brāhmaṇa akkosantaṃ paccakkosati, rosentaṃ paṭiroseti, bhaṇḍantaṃ paṭibhaṇḍati, ayaṃ vuccati brāhmaṇa sambhuñjati vītiharati.
sn7.2:3.2: te mayaṃ tayā neva sambhuñjāma na vītiharāma
sn7.2:3.5: [brāhmaṇo:] bhavantaṃ kho gotamaṃ sarājikā parisā evaṃ jānāti:
sn7.2:3.7: atha ca pana bhavaṃ gotamo kujjhatīti.
sn7.2:8.1: evaṃ vutte akkosakabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn7.2:8.3: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
sn7.2:8.4: labheyyāhaṃ bhoto gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
sn7.2:9.1: alattha kho akkosakabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alattha upasampadaṃ.
sn7.2:9.2: acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā akkosakabhāradvājo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
sn7.2:9.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn7.2:9.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosīti.
